title: BBC Learning English from the News 2025 — Quiz 9
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q081_new_reality
elements.title: After the only grocery shop closed, travelling to another town for food became residents' ___.

elements.name: q082_play_out
elements.title: “Let’s wait and see how the talks play out.” What does “play out” mean here?

elements.name: q083_lash_out
elements.title: He suddenly began to ___ at his colleagues, shouting insults across the room.

elements.name: q084_pay_off
elements.title: All those hours of practice began to ___ when her accuracy improved.

elements.name: q085_barrage
elements.title: Immediately after the announcement, the office received a ___ of calls.

elements.name: q086_zero_in_on
elements.title: The tutor helped me ___ the one error I kept making rather than reviewing everything.

elements.name: q087_to_do_with_something
elements.title: The delay had nothing ___ the weather; it was caused by a technical fault.

elements.name: q088_curfew
elements.title: A ___ required everyone to be off the streets by ten at night.

elements.name: q089_quell
elements.title: The staff took steps to ___ panic and restore calm.

elements.name: q090_a_self_fulfilling_prophecy
elements.title: She expected to fail, so she stopped practising and ended up failing. Her expectation became ___.
